title: Rates as Equations
description: A rate says how fast something changes; add up the changes, a small step at a time, and you have what happens. Unlocks the Integrator and the Rate Table.

puzzle.goal: Something decays as dy/dt = −ky. Take one step of size h from the value y. Write the next value Y.
puzzle.name: Euler step
puzzle.ask: Find Y for y = @{y}, h = 0.1 and k = @{k}.
puzzle.method: Over a short step the rate barely changes: the change is the rate now, −ky, times the step h.
